stories.title: Lawrence, Jags pull away from Joe Fagnano, Ravens
stories.summary: The Jaguars never trailed in a comfortable win over the short-handed Ravens in Baltimore.

stories.title: No. 9 LSU women make history with 109-point rout over Texas Southern
stories.summary: No. 9 LSU cruised to a 131-22 win over Texas Southern, the largest win in Division I history against a Division I opponent

stories.title: Source: RB Smothers done for season with torn MCL amid No. 7 Texas' injury woes
stories.summary: Hollywood Smothers will miss the rest of the season for the Longhorns, who are seeing their injury issues mount.

stories.title: Jags in elite company with latest blowout win, feel they can be 'way better'
stories.summary: The Jaguars racked up their fourth win by 23 or more points this season in Thursday night's 33-10 rout of the Ravens and believe there's room to be even better.

stories.title: Chiefs WR Rice files for bankruptcy, claims he owes over $3.45M in debts
stories.summary: Chiefs wide receiver Rashee Rice filed for bankruptcy in federal court, claiming he has more than $3.45 million in debts.
